page.title: Live session
page.purpose: Operate a device under an explicit lease, with the holder, the expiry, and the kill control always visible.

priorities.statement: The lease holder, its expiry, and a one-click kill are always visible while the session is live.
priorities.notes: This scenario can drive a personal device. Session visibility is a safety property, not a convenience.

priorities.statement: Every control is operable and every state perceivable without the video frame.
priorities.notes: The frame is evidence, not the interface. A failed or unloaded frame must not disable control.

priorities.statement: Each dispatched verb appears in a running audit list with its outcome.
priorities.notes: The operator should never wonder whether an action reached the device.

states.description: Another consumer holds the lease; the holder and expiry are named.
Lease held; verbs dispatchable; frame streaming.
Lease held but no frame; all controls and state remain operable.
Session terminated; further verbs refused with that reason.
